subject: CareBridge: Activation - streaming & structured outputs kickoff
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carebridge.health>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@carebridge.health>
Date: 2028-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CareBridge: Activation - streaming & structured outputs kickoff

Hi Sarah — great to meet you over the call last week. Per our conversation I pulled together an initial MVP implementation plan and a couple of example schema files to accelerate the handoff. Attached: CB_MVP_implementation_plan.xlsx and schema_examples_v0.1.json.

High-level asks from Redwood:
- Confirm target product flows that need streaming + function calling (voice transcription pipeline, triage assistant).
- Sanity-check required fields in structured outputs (patient_id, encounter_id, intent, confidence).
- Identify sandbox recipients for token/access provisioning.

Proposed kickoff window: Aug 24–25 (US-PST). If that works, I will loop in our CS and integration leads to finalize the mutual action plan.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Success Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0142
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carebridge.health>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@carebridge.health>
Date: 2028-08-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareBridge: Activation - streaming & structured outputs kickoff

Thanks Vanessa — received and reviewing. Raj and I skimmed the MVP plan; high level looks good. A few quick notes:
- We definitely want streaming in the voice-to-summary flow (low-latency incremental summaries).
- Function/tool calling will be used to call our Roster service (lookup patient metadata) and our Records API (fetch consented notes).

Can you include your CS and integration leads on the next note? Also we need to ensure any sandbox keys are scoped to scrubbed data; I will follow up with our security contact if needed.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Product Operations | CareBridge Health
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carebridge.health>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@carebridge.health>, marissa.cole@redwood.inference, ben.carter@redwood.inference, monica.patel@redwood.inference
Date: 2028-08-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareBridge: Activation - streaming & structured outputs kickoff

Great — looping in our implementation team.

Marissa / Ben / Monica: CareBridge will use streaming for voice summarization and function calls to validate patient context. Please review the attached MVP plan and the schema examples; I added a Miro board for the sprint map (link in related_links).

Proposed mutual action plan (draft):
1) Week 0 (this week): finalize schema fields + sandbox user list.
2) Week 1: token provisioning + basic connectivity tests (ping, health checks).
3) Week 2–3: streaming pilot (1k concurrent sessions target) + function-call integration (Roster + Records).
4) Week 4: structured output verification + regression evals.

Ask from CareBridge: confirm sandbox user emails and any security questionnaire items we should pre-fill (SOC 2 scope, data retention).

Thanks all — I’ll schedule a 60-minute kickoff for Aug 24 and send calendar invites once times are confirmed.

— Vanessa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, marissa.cole@redwood.inference, monica.patel@redwood.inference
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carebridge.health>, Raj Patel <raj@carebridge.health>
Date: 2028-08-17T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareBridge: Activation - streaming & structured outputs kickoff

Thanks Vanessa — quick technical notes for the thread so CareBridge can prep: 

- Streaming: we recommend starting with a max-inflight tokens of 384 and a windowed commit at 128 to balance latency/cost. If your utterances average > 4k tokens, call this out and we can recommend a different batching profile.
- Function/tool calling: payload example below (we'll validate final contract in the schema file):

{
  "function": "get_patient_record",
  "args": {
    "patient_id": "string",
    "consent_token": "string",
    "requested_fields": ["allergies", "meds", "recent_encounters"]
  }
}

- JSON schema versioning: we'll accept v0.2 schema files; please include example payloads in your sample responses so we can run the schema tests in our pipeline.

I'll prepare a short runbook for token rotation and KV-cache warmup prior to the pilot.

— Ben Carter
Integration Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carebridge.health>, Raj Patel <raj@carebridge.health>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, ben.carter@redwood.inference, monica.patel@redwood.inference
Date: 2028-08-19T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareBridge: Activation - streaming & structured outputs kickoff

Sarah / Raj — attached is an updated sprint board and a proposed task list for Weeks 0–4 (attachment: carebridge_schema_v0.2.json included sample payloads and required/optional fields). Highlights: 

- Week 0 (schema lock): finalize fields for `patient_id` (string), `encounter_ts` (ISO8601), `intent` (enum), `confidence` (0-1 float), `entities` (array of objects).
- Week 1 (connectivity): sandbox keys issued to the below emails: onboarding+carebridge@redwood.inference, dev+carebridge@redwood.inference (we request CareBridge confirm).
- Week 2 (pilot): finish streaming sanity tests and instrument the latency SLO tracing hooks.

Please confirm the required responsibility owner for consent token issuance on your side so we can map the API handshake. If we do not hear back by Aug 22, we will assume Raj as the primary contact.

Thanks — small ask list for the kickoff:
- Confirm sandbox recipients by Aug 21.
- Provide a scrubbed sample payload (PHI removed) for schema test harness by Aug 22.

— Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carebridge.health>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, marissa.cole@redwood.inference, ben.carter@redwood.inference, monica.patel@redwood.inference
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@carebridge.health>
Date: 2028-08-22T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareBridge: Activation - streaming & structured outputs kickoff

Thanks everyone — confirming Aug 24 at 10am PT for the kickoff.

Answers to the immediate asks:
- Sandbox recipients: onboarding+carebridge@carebridge.health, dev+carebridge@carebridge.health (tokens will be scoped to scrubbed test data).
- Sample payload: attached (safe_sample_payload.json) — PHI stripped.
- Consent token owner: Raj (cc'd) will own token issuance and mapping.
- Security checklist: please send your SOC 2 scoping doc and any additional questions; our InfoSec will run through and follow up.

See you on Thursday.

Best,
Sarah
